[P1] 萤火虫 世界经典童话双语绘本
The Little Prince
小王子
（法）圣埃克苏佩里 著
外语教学与研究出版社
FOREIGN LANGUAGE TEACHING AND RESEARCH PRESS

[P2] 萤火虫 世界经典童话双语绘本
The Little Prince
小王子
（法）圣埃克苏佩里 著

[P3] 我是一名孤独的飞行员，一直孤独地飞行着。六年前，飞机出了故障，不得不着陆在一片沙漠里。正当我修理飞机的时候，突然听到一个很小的声音：“请给我画一只绵羊，好吗？”
“什么？”我从飞机里跳出来，惊讶地发现面前站着一个小人儿。他就是小王子。小王子微笑着，再次请我为他画一只羊。

[P4] 看着这个严肃的小家伙，我提起笔画了一只羊。他仔细地看了一会儿，摇摇头说：“这只羊病了。”我又画了一只。他微笑地看着这只羊说：“他有角，是公羊，我想要的是一只绵羊。”我又画了第三幅。他还是不满意，他说，“这只羊太老了。”
我变得不耐烦了，就随手画了只箱子，我告诉他，“你要的绵羊就在箱子里面。”小王子笑了，他说：“这才是我想要的。你瞧，小绵羊在箱子里睡着了。”我听了，感到很惊奇。

[P5] 随后，小王子说，他的星球上有一株花，他看着她从一粒种子慢慢长大。一天清晨，太阳升起的时候，这株花突然盛开了，美得令人心动。小王子很快就爱上了这朵花。有一天这朵花对我说：‘我很怕被风吹，你能为我找一个屏风吗？这里太冷了，我原来住的那个地方……’那朵花嘟着嘴，没有再说下去。事实上，这个星球是她知道的唯一一个星球。小王子明白了她在撒谎，决定离开。

[P6] 小王子来到了旅途中的第一颗行星。这里住着一位国王，他认为天下所有人都是他的臣民。小王子走了很远的路，累得打起哈欠来。
国王命令道：“我不准你打哈欠。”“可我实在忍不住了。”“那好吧，我命令你打哈欠。”国王说。
小王子打起哈欠来，又对国王说：“国王，我想问你个问题。”“那我命令你向我提问题。”“您为什么这么爱命令别人呢？”小王子想问的就是这个问题，他无法理解。他打了个哈欠，就离开了。

[P7] 第二颗行星上住着一个自大的人，他认为所有人都是他的崇拜者。小王子对他说：“你好。你的帽子真奇怪。”“这是用来向崇拜我的人致意用的。快，说你崇拜我，然后鼓掌致敬。”“可是，请问崇拜是什么意思？”“崇拜嘛，就是承认我是这个星球上最英俊、最聪明的人。”那位先生说。
“可是你的星球上只有你一个人啊！”“那就请你成全我，说你崇拜我吧！”“那好吧，我崇拜你。”小王子无可奈何地说道，“这个人太爱自己了。”说完，小王子就离开了。

[P8] 第三颗行星上住着一个酒鬼。小王子问他：“你为什么要喝这么多酒呢？”“为了要忘记。”“忘记什么？”小王子突然觉得这个酒鬼有点儿可怜。“忘记让我羞愧的事。”“那你羞愧什么呢？”“我为喝酒而羞愧。”那个酒鬼举起酒瓶又开始喝酒了。小王子迷惑不解，“可是，你不能用错误的方法来弥补错误啊。”说完，小王子就又离开了。

[P9] 在第四颗行星上小王子遇到一个商人。
“你好！”“三加二等于五。你好。
五加七等于十二……哎哟！一共是五亿零一百万！”“请问，五亿零一百万是什么？”“嗯？我太忙了！三加二等于五……
一共是……”那个商人又开始埋头计算了。
小王子最终弄明白了答案，原来是五亿零一百万颗星星！这位商人认为所有星星都是他的，所以他一直在数。
“这个商人太贪心了！难道他不知道，星星只为了它们自己而存在吗？”小王子觉得这位商人的想法难以理解，就走了。

[P10] 第五颗行星是最小的，上面刚好只能容纳一盏路灯和一个点灯的人。
“早上好。你刚才为什么把路灯熄灭了呢？”“早上好。白天熄灯、晚上点灯，这是规矩呀。”“白天？你的星球这么小，一分钟就能转一圈呢。”“是啊，所以我每分钟都要点一次、熄一次呢。”说着这个人又点亮了路灯，因为眨眼间白天已经过去了。
小王子有点儿喜欢这个忠于职守的人了，但是这个星球实在是太小，所以他还是离开了。

[P11] 第六颗行星上住着一位正在写鸿篇巨著的老先生。
小王子问他：“您在这里干什么呢？”“我是一个地理学家。我在写书，我研究大海、研究河流，还有沙漠。”“真有趣！那你的星球上有海洋吗？”“这我倒没法儿知道。”“可是，你不是个地理学家吗？”“是的，我是个地理学家，但我不是一个探险家。”“好吧。不过我更喜欢到处走一走，那样才能学到真正的东西。那你建议我接下来去哪个星球呢？”
那位老先生看了看小王子，然后回答道：“去地球吧。”

[P12] 小王子旅途的第七站就是地球了！他落在沙漠里，遇见了一条毒蛇。
蛇问他：“你到这儿来干什么？”“我……我和一朵花闹了别扭。”“啊！”小王子和蛇都沉默了下来。小王子长时间地打量着蛇：“你是个奇怪的动物，细得像根手指！”“不不不，我可是很厉害的哦！凡是我咬过的人，都会丧命。可你是纯洁的，而且来自另一个星球，所以我不会伤害你。”随后，他们再一次陷入了沉默。

[P13] 小王子穿越沙漠，来到一座花园里。
“你们好。”小王子对花园里的花说道。花儿们回答：“你好。”小王子盯着这些花，她们长得都很像他那朵。“你们是谁？”“我们？我们是玫瑰啊。”
小王子很难过，“我以为我拥有世界上独一无二的花，可这里竟有这么多和她几乎一样的花。”

[P14] 这时，一只狐狸跑了过来。小王子对他说：“狐狸，我很苦恼，能过来和我一起玩儿吗？”
“不行，我还没有被驯服呢。”“驯服？驯服是什么意思？”“驯服就是彼此需要。对我来说，你只是一个普通的小男孩儿，我不需要你。对你来说，我也只是一只普通的狐狸，你也不需要我。但是如果驯服了我，我们就互相不可缺少了。”听到这儿，小王子点了点头，“我有一点儿明白了。有一朵花……我想，她把我驯服了……”

[P15] 过了一会儿，小王子遇见了一位铁路扳道工。他走上去问道：“请问，你在这里做什么呢？”“我嘛，我把旅客们送上火车，之后发车，一会儿往右发，一会儿往左发。”这时，一列灯火通明的列车轰隆而过。小王子问：“他们这么匆忙，要去找什么呢？”扳道工说：“他们自己也不知道，都在里面睡觉呢。”小王子若有所思地说：“只有孩子知道自己在寻找什么。他们会为了一个布娃娃一直哭啊哭啊……”扳道工回应小王子：“是啊，孩子是幸运的。”

[P16] 当我遇到小王子的第八天，小王子他决定回家了。小王子对我说：“你知道——我的花……我应该对她负责任。她那么柔弱，我要保护她。”我对小王子说：“可是小家伙，我还想听到你笑……”“那么在夜晚，在夜晚当你仰望星空的时候，我就在那里对着你笑呢。”
小王子的话刚说完，一道黄光闪过，他轻轻地倒在了地上。我知道他已经回到了他的星球。如果你在沙漠里遇到一个小人儿，有着金色的头发，灿烂地微笑着，那就是小王子。
full_text_en:
[P1] Firefly World Classic Fairy Tale Bilingual Picture Book
The Little Prince
The Little Prince
(France) Saint-Exupéry
Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press
FOREIGN LANGUAGE TEACHING AND RESEARCH PRESS

[P2] Firefly World Classic Fairy Tale Bilingual Picture Book
The Little Prince
The Little Prince
(France) Saint-Exupéry, Author

[P3] I am a lonely pilot, always flying alone. Six years ago, my plane malfunctioned and I was forced to land in a desert. While I was repairing the plane, I suddenly heard a very small voice: "Please draw me a sheep, okay?"
"What?" I jumped out of the plane, surprised to find a tiny little person standing before me. He was the Little Prince. The Little Prince smiled and asked me again to draw him a sheep.

[P4] Looking at this serious little fellow, I picked up my pen and drew a sheep. He looked at it carefully for a moment, then shook his head and said, "This sheep is sick." I drew another one. He smiled at it and said, "It has horns; it's a ram. I want a lamb." I drew a third one. He was still not satisfied, saying, "This sheep is too old." 
I became impatient and drew a box at random. I told him, "Your lamb is inside the box." The Little Prince smiled and said, "That's exactly what I wanted. Look, the little lamb is sleeping inside the box." I listened and felt very surprised.

[P5] Then, the Little Prince said, on his planet there was a flower, and he watched her grow from a single seed. One morning, as the sun rose, the flower suddenly bloomed, beautiful enough to move the heart. The Little Prince quickly fell in love with the flower. One day, the flower said to me: 'I'm afraid of the wind. Could you find me a screen? It's too cold here. The place I used to live...' The flower pouted and said no more. In fact, this planet was the only one she knew. The Little Prince realized she was lying, and decided to leave.

[P6] The Little Prince arrived at the first planet on his journey. There lived a king who believed everyone in the world was his subject. The Little Prince had walked a long way and was tired, yawning.

The king commanded, "I forbid you to yawn." "But I can't help it," the Little Prince replied. "Very well, then I command you to yawn," said the king.

The Little Prince yawned, then said to the king, "King, I would like to ask you a question." "Then I command you to ask me a question." "Why do you love giving orders to others so much?" This was the question the Little Prince wanted to ask. He couldn't understand it. He yawned once more and left.

[P7] On the second planet lived a conceited man who believed everyone was his worshipper. The Little Prince said to him, "Hello. Your hat is very strange." "It's used to salute those who worship me. Quickly, say you worship me, and then clap your hands in reverence." "But, what does 'worship' mean?" "Worship means acknowledging that I am the most handsome and the smartest person on this planet," the gentleman said.
"But there's only you on your planet!" "Then please do me a favor and say you worship me!" "Alright then, I worship you," the Little Prince said helplessly, "This person loves himself too much." After saying that, the Little Prince left.

[P8] On the third planet lived a drunkard. The Little Prince asked him, “Why do you drink so much?” “To forget.” “Forget what?” The Little Prince suddenly felt a bit sorry for the drunkard. “I forget the things that make me ashamed.” “Then what are you ashamed of?” “I’m ashamed of drinking.” The drunkard raised his bottle and began drinking again. The Little Prince was puzzled, “But you can’t fix a mistake with another mistake.” After saying this, the Little Prince left once more.

[P9] On the fourth planet, the Little Prince met a businessman.
"Hello!" "Three plus two equals five. Hello.
Five plus seven equals twelve... Oh my! That's five hundred million and one hundred thousand!" "Excuse me, what is five hundred million and one hundred thousand?" "Huh? I'm too busy! Three plus two equals five... 
That's..." The businessman started calculating again.
The Little Prince finally understood the answer: five hundred million and one hundred thousand stars! The businessman believed all the stars belonged to him, so he kept counting them.
"This businessman is too greedy! Doesn't he know that stars exist for themselves?" The Little Prince found the businessman's thoughts incomprehensible and left.

[P10] The fifth planet was the smallest, and on it there was just enough room for a streetlamp and a lamplighter.
"Good morning. Why did you just turn off the lamp?" "Good morning. Turning it off during the day and turning it on at night—that's the rule." "Daytime? Your planet is so small, it makes a full rotation in just one minute." "Exactly, so I have to turn it on and off every minute." Saying this, the man lit the lamp again, because daytime had already passed in the blink of an eye.
The Little Prince liked this dedicated man a little, but the planet was too small, so he still left.

[P11] On the sixth planet lived an old gentleman writing a great work.
Little Prince asked him, “What are you doing here?” “I am a geographer. I am writing a book. I study oceans, rivers, and deserts.” “How interesting! Does your planet have oceans?” “I can’t say for sure.” “But aren’t you a geographer?” “Yes, I am a geographer, but I am not an explorer.” “Well, I prefer to wander around. That’s how I learn real things. So, which planet do you suggest I visit next?”
The old man looked at Little Prince and replied, “Go to Earth.”

[P12] The seventh stop on the Little Prince's journey was Earth! He landed in the desert and met a venomous snake.
The snake asked him, "What are you doing here?" "I... I had a quarrel with a flower." "Ah!" Both the Little Prince and the snake fell silent. The Little Prince looked at the snake for a long time: "You're a strange creature, thin as a finger!" "No, no, no, I'm very powerful! Anyone I bite dies. But you are pure, and you come from another planet, so I won't harm you." Then, they fell into silence once again.

[P13] The Little Prince crossed the desert and arrived at a garden.
"Hello," the Little Prince said to the flowers in the garden. The flowers replied, "Hello." The Little Prince stared at the flowers; they all looked very much like his own. "Who are you?" "Us? We are roses!"
The Little Prince felt very sad. "I thought I had the one and only flower in the world, but here there are so many that are almost exactly like her."

[P14] At this moment, a fox ran over. The Little Prince said to him, "Fox, I'm very troubled. Can you come and play with me?"
"No, I haven't been tamed yet." "Tamed? What does 'tamed' mean?" "To tame means to need each other. To me, you're just an ordinary little boy, and I don't need you. To you, I'm just an ordinary fox, and you don't need me. But if you tame me, we will become indispensable to each other." Hearing this, the Little Prince nodded. "I understand a little now. There is a flower... I think, she has tamed me..."

[P15] After a while, the Little Prince met a railway switchman. He walked up and asked, "Excuse me, what are you doing here?" "Well, I put the travelers onto the train, then send it off—sometimes to the right, sometimes to the left." At that moment, a brightly lit train roared by. The Little Prince asked, "They're so busy—what are they looking for?" The switchman replied, "They themselves don't know. They're all sleeping inside." The Little Prince said thoughtfully, "Only children know what they are looking for. They can cry and cry over a single doll..." The switchman responded to the Little Prince, "Yes, children are lucky."

[P16] On the eighth day since I met the Little Prince, he decided to go home. The Little Prince said to me: "You know—my flower... I should be responsible for her. She is so fragile, I must protect her." I said to the Little Prince: "But little one, I still want to hear you laugh..." "Then, at night, when you look up at the stars, I will be there, smiling at you." 
As soon as the Little Prince finished speaking, a flash of yellow light appeared, and he gently fell to the ground. I knew he had returned to his planet. If you meet a little man in the desert, with golden hair, smiling brightly, that is the Little Prince.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小王子》的封面，展示了小王子站在星球上仰望星空的插图，并标注了书名、作者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《小王子》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息及系列标识，背景为卷轴设计，配有星星装饰。
[P3] 飞行员在沙漠中修理飞机时，遇到一个名叫小王子的小孩，小王子请求他画一只绵羊。
[P4] 飞行员为小王子画了三只羊，但小王子都不满意。最后飞行员画了一个箱子，小王子却非常高兴，认为箱子里的绵羊正是他想要的。
[P5] 小王子讲述了他星球上那朵花的来历，以及他如何爱上她，但后来发现花在撒谎，于是决定离开。
[P6] 小王子来到第一颗行星，遇见了一位自认为统治所有人的国王。小王子因疲倦而打哈欠，国王先是禁止他打哈欠，后又命令他打哈欠。小王子想问国王为何如此爱发号施令，但国王却命令他提问，小王子无法理解，最终打了个哈欠离开了。
[P7] 小王子来到第二颗行星，遇见一位自大的人，对方要求他崇拜自己并鼓掌致敬。小王子无奈地配合，但认为此人太爱自己，随后离开。
[P8] 小王子来到第三颗行星，遇见一个酒鬼。酒鬼因羞愧而喝酒，又因喝酒而羞愧，陷入循环。小王子指出他用错误的方法弥补错误，随后离开。
[P9] 小王子来到第四颗行星，遇见一位商人，商人正忙着数星星并声称所有星星都属于他。小王子认为商人过于贪婪，无法理解他的想法，于是离开。
[P10] 小王子来到第五颗行星，遇见一位负责点灯和熄灯的守灯人。由于星球极小，每分钟自转一圈，守灯人必须每分钟开关灯一次。小王子欣赏他的尽职，但因星球太小而离开。
[P11] 小王子来到第六颗行星，遇见一位自称为地理学家的老先生，对方虽研究地理却从未实地探索。小王子认为真正的知识来自亲身经历，最终老先生建议他前往地球。
[P12] 小王子来到地球的沙漠中，遇见了一条毒蛇。蛇询问他的来意，小王子回答与一朵花闹了别扭。双方沉默后，小王子观察蛇并称其奇怪，蛇则表示自己虽厉害但不会伤害来自外星的纯洁之人，最后他们再次陷入沉默。
[P13] 小王子来到一座花园，发现许多与他星球上那朵玫瑰几乎一模一样的花，感到非常难过，因为他以为自己拥有独一无二的花。
[P14] 小王子在花园中遇见一只狐狸，向它倾诉苦恼，狐狸解释了‘驯服’的含义，小王子由此联想到自己星球上的玫瑰，意识到她已驯服了自己。
[P15] 小王子在地球上遇见一位铁路扳道工，询问旅客们匆忙的目的，扳道工回答他们不知所求，只知在火车上睡觉，小王子感慨只有孩子才真正知道自己在寻找什么。
[P16] 小王子在与叙述者告别时，表达了对玫瑰的责任与思念，随后在一道黄光中消失，叙述者相信他已回到自己的星球。
[P17] 画面中，小王子趴在一只箱子上，箱子侧面画着一只正在睡觉的小羊，小王子似乎在守护或思念他的小羊。
